procedures.title: Report timing and confirmation
procedures.text: Record who sent each report, when the observation was made, and when it was received. List missing information separately and keep it unconfirmed until a new report arrives.

provenance.note: Original standing-procedure choice (F6). Adoption does not reverse the experienced outcome, trust, or compulsory rehearsal.

procedures.title: Recovery cross-check
procedures.text: List air support and surface retrieval separately; distinguish requested from confirmed support.

provenance.note: Original standing-procedure choice (F6). Adoption does not reverse the experienced outcome, trust, or compulsory rehearsal.

procedures.title: Docked-flight contingency development
procedures.text: Develop and rehearse procedures for emergencies while docked. List the symptoms the crew and ground can observe, agree who passes each warning, and prepare for a loss of contact before a diagnosis is complete.

provenance.note: A commissioned program task, not a completed engineering procedure, flight rule or proven safety improvement. Its wording and adoption are original F10, inspired by the reported Kranz criticism; not an exact historical NASA corrective document.
